metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, were land surface temperatures along the Paris Olympic marathon starting line (Hôtel de Ville) lower than in the Fausses-Reposes forest near Versailles?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy. - Data set: Landsat 8 (Collection 2, Level-2) because it carries Surface Temperature (ST_B10) at 30 m and passes ~10:00 am local; we’ll pick the scene acquired closest to 1 August, 2024. - Date range: 1 Aug → 31 Aug 2024 (only one landing path will exist, but we’ll still filter to 6-Aug exact and fall back to ±3 d if that image is missing). - Bands to use: 'ST_B10' (surface temperature in Kelvin, scale factor 0.00341802 + 149·scale_factor). 2. Masking strategy. - Use the QA_PIXEL band; keep only the high-confidence land, clear-sky pixels (bits 0–3 = 0, bit 4 = 0). - Mask water via QA_PIXEL bit 7 = 0. 3. Logic to distinguish result. - If zero images exist → C1. - If after cloud/water masking both sites have zero valid 30-m pixels → C2. - If any mean temperature is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise compare the two means: “Hôtel de Ville cooler than forest?” → Yes = A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time (local time 13:40 → satellite ~10:00 UTC is fine for Landsat) hotel = ee.Geometry.Point([2.349, 48.857]) # Hôtel de Ville forest = ee.Geometry.Point([2.088, 48.808]) # Fausses-Reposes forest dateStart = '2024-08-06' dateEnd = '2024-08-07' widen = ee.DateRange('2024-08-03', '2024-08-09') def getT(loc, dr): col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(loc) .filterDate(dr)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 img = col.first() qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL') mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(0b11111001).eq(0) # land+clear+no-water st = img.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).subtract(273.15).updateMask(mask) cnt = st.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ST_B10') mean = st.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ST_B10') return mean.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo() tHotel, nHotel = getT(hotel, ee.DateRange(dateStart, dateEnd)) if tHotel is None: tHotel, nHotel = getT(hotel, widen) # fallback if tHotel is None: print("No image for Hotel.") print("C1") else: tForest, nForest = getT(forest, ee.DateRange(dateStart, dateEnd)) if tForest is None: tForest, nForest = getT(forest, widen) if tForest is None: print("No image for Forest.") print("C1") else: if nHotel == 0 or nForest == 0: print(f"Valid pixels Hotel:{nHotel} Forest:{nForest}") print("C2") elif tHotel is None or tForest is None: print("C3") else: print(f'Hotel T: {tHotel:.2f} °C (px {nHotel})') print(f'Forest T: {tForest:.2f} °C (px {nForest})') print("A" if tHotel < tForest else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time  (local time 13:40 → satellite ~10:00 UTC is fine for Landsat)
hotel = ee.Geometry.Point([2.349, 48.857])  # Hôtel de Ville
forest = ee.Geometry.Point([2.088, 48.808]) # Fausses-Reposes forest
dateStart = '2024-08-06'
dateEnd = '2024-08-07'
widen = ee.DateRange('2024-08-03', '2024-08-09')

def getT(loc, dr):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
             .filterBounds(loc)
             .filterDate(dr))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0
    img = col.first()
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(0b11111001).eq(0)   # land+clear+no-water
    st = img.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).subtract(273.15).updateMask(mask)
    cnt = st.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ST_B10')
    mean = st.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ST_B10')
    return mean.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo()

tHotel, nHotel = getT(hotel, ee.DateRange(dateStart, dateEnd))
if tHotel is None: tHotel, nHotel = getT(hotel, widen)      # fallback
if tHotel is None:
    print("No image for Hotel.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    tForest, nForest = getT(forest, ee.DateRange(dateStart, dateEnd))
    if tForest is None: tForest, nForest = getT(forest, widen)
    if tForest is None:
        print("No image for Forest.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        if nHotel == 0 or nForest == 0:
            print(f"Valid pixels Hotel:{nHotel} Forest:{nForest}")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        elif tHotel is None or tForest is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f'Hotel T: {tHotel:.2f} °C (px {nHotel})')
            print(f'Forest T: {tForest:.2f} °C (px {nForest})')
            print("<answer>A</answer>" if tHotel < tForest else "<answer>B</answer>")
